_comment: Copy to <bin>/external_compressors.json and edit. Each entry is one compressor: 'compress' and 'decompress' are command lines with placeholders {input} {compressed} {output} {eb} (absolute bound) {dims} (slowest first) {dims_fast} (fastest first) {d1} {d2} {d3} {ndims} {n} {threads}. The decompressed file must be raw float32 of the original size. Optional 'compress_time_regex' / 'decompress_time_regex' pick the time (seconds) from the program output; otherwise the wall time of the command is used. Entries starting with _ are ignored.
